name: haveibeensquatted
description: Analyze domains, hunt lookalikes, search certificate transparency and triage your organization's detections.

interface.longDescription: Analyze any domain live, scan for typosquats and unregistered lookalikes, search certificate transparency logs, and query and triage your organization's lookalike detections. Requires a Have I Been Squatted account; every call is scoped to the organization you choose when you sign in.
defaultPrompt: Triage this week's lookalike detections for my organization and flag the ones that look malicious
Search certificate transparency for new certificates imitating my company's domain in the last 30 days
Analyze this suspicious domain and tell me whether it looks like phishing infrastructure
